_comment: Occupant density/hours informed by ASHRAE 62.1 Table 6-1 (retail sales ~15 people/1000 ft^2) and EIA CBECS 2018 (food-sales category mean ~110 operating hours/week, i.e. ~16h/day) -- no dedicated DOE bakery prototype exists, closest DOE analog is Stand-alone Retail/Strip Mall. Early opening reflects pre-open baking; illustrative, not survey-calibrated. gain_w_per_m2 (30 W/m^2) approximates ASHRAE 90.1 Table 9.5.1 retail lighting power density (~1.14 W/ft^2 ~ 12.3 W/m^2) plus a substantial illustrative margin for oven/baking equipment running through most open hours -- higher than restaurant's since ovens are closer to continuously on rather than intermittent cooking. Blended with (not replacing) the per-occupant gains -- see core/buem_adapter.py to_buem_profiles().
description: Small bakery / neighborhood retail. Early opening for baking, open 7 days.
